candidates.text: Okay so everyone asks me the same question.
How do you edit a whole week of videos in one afternoon?
Um, honestly, for a year I couldn't.
The thing that changed everything was batching the hooks.
I write twenty hooks on Monday and film them back to back.
That one change took me from six hours to forty minutes.
Anyway, that's it. See you next week.
